fnol_text: My name is Dana Laurent and I live at 470 Sycamore Avenue, Riverton, WY 82527. You can reach me on (555) 229-2509 or dana.laurent@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 17 December 2025. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2025-00148. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Laurent on (555) 229-2509 to acknowledge the claim. Dana confirmed the loss date as 17 December 2025.
Site visit to 470 Sycamore Avenue. Neighbour Dana Whitfield was present and confirmed the timeline.
Dana sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
